description: Marketplace: prepare (unsigned) listing a game NFT you own for a fixed ETH price: first a one-time setApprovalForAll to the site's market contract (the only operator the NFT accepts), then list. Works for companions, operatives, fighters, crates, Portal disks; collection "weapons" lists an Armory weapon (tokenId = weapon id) on the weapon market. Not for the Override Disk or mercenaries.

collection.description: companions, operatives, fighters, crates or portal (or the contract address); or "weapons" for Armory weapons. NOT the Override Disk (Ripples' collection, trades on OpenSea) and NOT mercenaries (locked to the buyer).

tokenId.description: The token id (for weapons: the weapon id 1 to 13).

wallet.description: Your own 0x wallet address. Nothing is sent from it; it is used to read your balance and allowance and to simulate.

name: prepare_list_nft
